extractor: NFStream with the repository packet plugin

semantics.direction: The first packet fixes src2dst (forward); the reverse tuple is dst2src.
semantics.timing: IAT, active and idle statistics are integer microseconds derived from packet timestamps. A gap strictly greater than five seconds starts a new active period.
semantics.packet_and_payload_size: Bytes. Payload uses NFPacket.payload_size. Header size is max(ip_size - payload_size, 0). Zero-payload packets remain in packet and payload-size statistics.
semantics.dispersion: Population standard deviation; empty and singleton populations produce zero.
semantics.subflows: A gap strictly greater than one second starts a subflow; reported packet and byte values are arithmetic means across subflows.
semantics.bulk: A bulk is at least four positive-payload packets in one direction with no adjacent gap greater than one second. Rates are bytes per elapsed bulk seconds.
semantics.service: Lowercase nDPI application root; TLS and SSL normalize to ssl; otherwise a fixed known-destination-port fallback, then '-'.
semantics.tcp_windows: TCP receive window parsed from the captured IP packet; absent, truncated or non-TCP values are zero.
semantics.zero_rules: Missing directions, empty statistics, zero-duration rates and undefined ratios are represented as numeric zero.

compatibility.reason: Shared field names do not imply equivalent extractor values. This schema may only route to a native checksum-linked model bundle.
